games.watch: Several teams play LPL home matches in their own city; the rest play at the league’s arena in Shanghai. Tickets are on the Piaoxingqiu and Maoyan apps, and foreign passports are accepted.
KPL teams carry a home city in their name and play many matches there. The ticket notices we read did not say whether passports are accepted, so ask before you buy.
There is no Chinese league. Chinese teams play international events; when they qualify for one in China, such as IEM Beijing or the Shanghai Major, you can see them at home.
